subject: Proposed Ordinance
comment: Dear Planning Commissioners: I understand that the Provo Planning Commission meeting agenda for November 10th includes consideration of a new ordinance for the transfer of private infrastructure to the city. The Quail Valley Homeowners Association has been working with staff and city council members for years regarding the transfer of our neighborhood streets, fire protection, and certain other utilities to the city. In July, we met with Mayor Kafusi. Although we already had been responding to city processes for many months, at the Mayor's meeting, it was suggested that the city ought to have an ordinance to guide transfers like ours. Accordingly, the city began work on an ordinance. We provided feedback on the original draft ordinance several months ago. We have been consistently asking to see the revised ordinance proposal. As of yesterday, we were told it was not ready. We are concerned about formal action being taken by the Planning Commission next week before we, or any other citizens, have had an opportunity to see the proposed ordinance. I am sure you can appreciate our interest in the Planning Commission's recommendation on the ordinance since our neighborhood has been one of the primary motivations for the ordinance. I trust that the commission will receive background information and hear our comments about the ordinance, once it is available, before taking action. If available, I request a copy of the ordinance and an opportunity to provide feedback. Sincerely, Harlan M. Hatfield QVHA Committee Member
